question: Calculate the total income from Meat Lovers pizzas priced at $12 and Vegetarian pizzas at $10. Include any extra toppings charged at $1 each. Ensure that canceled orders are filtered out. How much money has Pizza Runner earned in total?
sql:
WITH pizza_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        pc.order_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN pc.pizza_id = 1 THEN 12.0 ELSE 10.0 END) as pizza_revenue
    FROM pizza_customer_orders pc
    JOIN pizza_runner_orders pro ON pc.order_id = pro.order_id
    WHERE pro.cancellation IS NULL OR pro.cancellation = ''
    AND pc.pizza_id IN (1, 2)
    GROUP BY pc.order_id
),
extras_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        order_id,
        SUM(extras_count) as total_extras,
        SUM(extras_count) as extras_revenue
    FROM pizza_get_extras
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT 
    SUM(pr.pizza_revenue) + COALESCE(SUM(er.extras_revenue), 0) as total_income
FROM pizza_revenue pr
LEFT JOIN extras_revenue er ON pr.order_id = er.order_id
